Company Overview

Northstar Analytics builds analytics and workflow automation software for operations teams in finance, healthcare operations, logistics, and professional services. Employees are expected to protect customer trust, communicate clearly, and make decisions that improve operational reliability.

Northstar has offices in Toronto, Montreal, and New York. The company supports hybrid work and approved remote work across Canada and the United States.

Work Model

Northstar supports hybrid work and approved remote work. Employees assigned to Toronto, Montreal, or New York offices are expected to attend office collaboration days when scheduled by their department.

Remote employees may work from approved locations in Canada or the United States if their role, tax location, and security requirements support remote work.

Company Holidays

Northstar observes 11 company holidays each year. Holiday calendars may vary by employee location. Employees should follow the holiday calendar assigned to their work location in the HR system.

rows.question: How many paid vacation days do full-time employees receive each calendar year?
rows.answer: Full-time employees receive 20 paid vacation days per calendar year.

citations.citation_text: Full-time employees receive 20 paid vacation days per calendar year.
citations.source: Source: HR-002 PTO and Leave Policy, Section: Vacation Entitlement

retrieved_chunks.content_preview:
Vacation Entitlement

Full-time employees receive 20 paid vacation days per calendar year. Vacation is accrued monthly and may be used after the employee's first 30 days of employment. Part-time employees receive prorated vacation based on scheduled weekly hours.

Employees may carry over up to 5 unused vacation days into the next calendar year. Carried-over days must be used by March 31 or they expire unless local law requires a different outcome.

Sick Leave

Employees receive 8 paid sick days per calendar year. Sick time may be used for personal illness, medical appointments, or short-term caregiving needs. Employees should notify their manager as soon as practical when taking sick leave.

Medical details should not be shared in team channels. People Operations may request documentation only when required by policy or law.

Parental Leave Summary

Eligible full-time employees may receive up to 12 weeks of company-supported parental leave after 6 months of service. Local statutory benefits may apply separately. Employees should contact People Operations at least 60 days before the expected leave date when possible.

This document provides a company policy summary and does not provide legal advice.

retrieved_chunks.content_preview:
Data Retention

Customer contracts must be retained for seven years after expiration. Vendor agreements must be retained for six years after termination. Employee agreements must be retained according to HR retention rules and any legal hold instructions.

Draft contracts that never reach signature may be deleted after 18 months unless they are part of an active dispute, audit, or legal hold. Executed agreements must never be deleted from the contract repository.

Escalation Triggers

Escalate to Legal before signature when a contract includes uncapped liability, customer audit rights broader than annual review, unusual data residency commitments, indemnity expansion, auto-renewal longer than one year, or commitments to future roadmap functionality.
